changes: URL patterns: add e.g. main--site--org.aem.page{path}{-'.html'} and the overlay opens the page matching the one you're on.
The popup shows which page the overlay will open, and on aemcoder the overlay follows the preview as you navigate.
Scrolling is synced automatically when you flip: the same content stays under the middle of the screen, or under the spot you clicked. This replaces Alt+click alignment.
Overlay pages are saved as bookmarks (Other bookmarks › FullyFrame), so they survive removing or reinstalling the extension.
Update notices: a green ↓ on the icon when a new version is on GitHub, and this list after you update.
Long URLs in the list scroll sideways, and search scrolls to the match.
The overlay covers the whole screen in DevTools device mode, even when the page is zoomed out.
Clicking the icon opens a popup with the view switch and the list of overlay pages.
Outside aemcoder, the overlay page covers the whole window.
The input searches the list or adds a new URL.
